% Font selection and line breaking: the parts most likely to move if a format
% file or an engine binary changed underneath a release.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{times}
\usepackage{latexsym}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{microtype}
\begin{document}
\section{Paragraphs}
A paragraph long enough to break over several lines, so that any change in
hyphenation, protrusion or font metrics moves a glyph and shows up as a
different page. Microtype adjusts the margins character by character, which
makes this sensitive to the exact font programme the engine loads.
\subsection{Symbols}
Symbols from latexsym: $\Box$, $\Diamond$, $\lhd$, and ordinary maths
$\alpha\beta\gamma$.
\end{document}
